name: The Long Dusk: lamplighter taste difference check
brief: Design Ilo, the playable lamplighter of The Long Dusk, for one moment on the Vesper Cliffs: walking the cliff road, answering the keeper and waking the cold beacon. My audience loves Hollow Knight, Spirited Away, Sigur Rós, Nujabes and the film Paterson. Make Ilo a character this audience would want to play: their look, the way they move and the way they speak. Keep the world, its lore, the keeper and Ilo's fixed facts. Write the character's description and lines in English.

fixedFacts.name: Ilo

abilities.name: Kindle
abilities.description: Wake a cold beacon with the flame you carry.

abilities.name: Carried flame
abilities.description: The light you carry pushes the dusk back around you.

rules: Ilo carries a light that can be seen in the dusk.
Ilo walks the road and does not fly or teleport.
